Windie Renberth is a UFS soldier, that originally was a Taimanin.

Personality
She originally had a strong and confident personality, but now, after being betrayed, has become a little distrustful of humans. Windie doesn't trust people and is guided only by her goal of finding a certain person, that betrayed her in the past, even laughing insane if she thinks her goal is getting close.

She is serious and mostly in a bad mood, but can act flirty. Her loyalty in the UFS is only based on intel of the person she wants to find and kill. Though she doesn't trust people, she will act reckless if somebody promises her intel, being open to sex as payment or other things.

Appearance
She is a woman with a large bust, green eyes and long blond hair.

History
Background
She once lived in Gosha Village but was betrayed by a person within the village.

A former Taimanin woman currently working as a soldier in the American Federation. She is currently a member of the UFS Special Forces and is primarily involved in intelligence activities. She originally worked as a Taimanin and was an intelligence agent, but during one mission she was betrayed by her comrades and forced to leave Gosha Village. When she was being chased from his village, she was rescued by the UFS, and ended up conducting intelligence activities there as a way to repay the favor. At that time, in order to avoid being chased by the villagers, the original name was abandoned and changed to a Western name. While working for the United States Federation, Windy obtains information that the Taimanin who framed her has already disappeared from the village, so she searches for the missing Taimanin while on a mission.

Timeline TABA
Makes possibly a deal with Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) in her "what if" event. In exchange for data about the person she is looking for, she becomes Kotaro underling.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Sword

Ninja Art: "Wind Art", "Silent Strike" mutes sounds made by the user. Her ability is a wind-based ninja technique, which can block the air vibrations that generate certain sounds, temporarily rendering the area silent. By using this around the feet, it is possible to extremely suppress the sound of shoes and boots. Wears, additional heavy combat gear, and can move fully silent regardless.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
